description: Zobolin stage E steps 4 and 4b: the slice region's 8 views (town square, town street, inside a house, lake shore, river bank, over the region, the town at night, far_horizon looking west over the far land) in the 131 km world record with its 8 x 8 km built window and the far land beyond it. With -Ablate -Kind gpu: the far land (drawing only). With -Ablate -Kind cpu: the river current (floating things and the boat pushed every physics step) and the window edge (haze and holding the player inside).
